page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Configure your UltraTorrent instance.
page.emptyDescription: This instance does not expose editable settings yet.
page.generalDescription: Values are validated by the server on save.

rootPath.title: Default Root Path
rootPath.description: Users can browse only inside this root path. Parent folders and system directories outside it are blocked.
rootPath.error: Could not load the root path.
rootPath.notWritableWarning: The app process cannot write to this path — downloads and folder creation there will fail.
rootPath.label: Root path

help.before: Must be a directory within the server's configured storage roots (
help.after: ). Browsing can only be narrowed within these, never widened past them.

bandwidth.title: Per-engine bandwidth
bandwidth.description: A ceiling applied to each torrent engine separately. The Activity Scheduler overrides it only on engines it is actually managing.
bandwidth.emptyMeansUnlimited: Leave a field empty for unlimited. Nothing is applied to any engine until you save a ceiling here.
bandwidth.unreachable: These engines cannot apply a global rate limit, so these values do not reach them: {{engines}}
bandwidth.saveFailed: Could not save the bandwidth limits
bandwidth.aggregate_one: This ceiling is in force on {{count}} engine, so it is also your installation total.
bandwidth.aggregate_other: This ceiling is in force on {{count}} engines, and each gets the full amount — so the most UltraTorrent can use altogether is {{down}} down and {{up}} up. Every shipped engine sets its own limit and cannot see the others, so there is no shared total to enforce.
